title: Sum of Interior Angles
description: The sum of all interior angles of a polygon having n sides.

example.question: Find the sum of interior angles of a hexagon.

title: Each Interior Angle (Regular Polygon)
description: Calculates the measure of each interior angle of a regular polygon.

example.question: Find each interior angle of a regular octagon.

title: Each Exterior Angle
description: The measure of each exterior angle of a regular polygon.

example.question: Find each exterior angle of a regular decagon.

note: Sum of all exterior angles is always 360°.

title: Sum of Exterior Angles
description: The sum of one exterior angle at each vertex of any polygon.

example.question: Find the sum of exterior angles of a 20-sided polygon.

note: Independent of the number of sides.

title: Number of Diagonals
description: Calculates the total number of diagonals in a polygon.

example.question: How many diagonals does an octagon have?

note: Every diagonal joins two non-adjacent vertices.

title: Number of Triangles
description: A polygon can be divided into n − 2 triangles by drawing diagonals from one vertex.

example.question: Into how many triangles can a nonagon be divided?

note: Useful for deriving the interior angle sum formula.

title: Central Angle
description: The angle subtended at the center by each side of a regular polygon.

example.question: Find the central angle of a regular pentagon.

note: Equal to each exterior angle in a regular polygon.

title: Perimeter of Regular Polygon
description: The perimeter of a regular polygon is the product of the number of sides and the length of one side.

example.question: Find the perimeter of a regular hexagon with side 8 cm.
